notes.title: Hotfix #2 😺🔧
notes.content:
[h1]Meowdy Rangers! [/h1]

We've rustled up some fixes, with more on the way, thank you so much for your love and support! 
Here's a list of fixes for you!

[list]
[*][b]Key Binding Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Previous bound keys are no longer removed. Note: There is still a 'replace' prompt screen that appears when trying to change a key binding already in use, but it will not replace it. Players can now assign keys wherever they wish. The 'replace' pop-up will be removed in the next patch, but for the current purposes, this issue is fixed.
[/list]
[b]Controller Menu:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now use the controller to select menu options with a button press, eliminating the need to navigate via the radial menu.
[/list]
[b]Apple Spawn Rate Increase:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the spawn rates of apples. Inconsistent spawns were leading to frustration, especially for the opening quest where players need to collect 3 apples. There should now be plentiful amounts available for players to complete the quest.
[/list]
[b]Stickball Achievement:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stickball achievement now works correctly.
[/list]
[b]Log Spawning:[/b]
[list]
[*] Logs now spawn on the ground, resolving floating log issues.
[/list]
[/list]


Please report any bugs or issues you encounter while playing the game [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2171570/discussions/0/4364626769119622248/]here[/url], and we will do our best to address them!

We have more fixes on the way so make sure to follow us here and on socials!
